rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE OWNERSHIP, POSSESSION AND CARRYING OF FIREARMS OUTSIDE OF RESIDENCE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Firearms Regulation Act of 1995" Provides for the regulation and licensure for the legal ownerhsip and possession of firearms and ammunizations by qualified citizens; allows the carrying of such firearms outside of one's residence in accordance with the provisions of this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING FROM INCOME TAXATION THE FIRST THREE YEARS SALARY OF SCHOOL TEACHERS, BOTH IN PUBLIC AND PRIVATE ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOLS
rows.abstract: Provides incentives to new government school teachers during their first years of service by giving them exemptions from payment of their income taxes during the fist three (3) years of employment.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09077

rows.abstract: Seeks to correct the particular restriction applicable to a relative employee by providing that "NEITHER SHALL IT BE APPLICABLE TO A RELATIVE EMPLOYEE WHO HAD BEEN IN THE SERVICE FOR MORE THAN FIVE (5) YEARS PRIOR TO HIS PROMOTIONAL APPOINTMENT EITHER IN RANK OR IN SALARY."

rows.author: A007
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL LIQUIFIED PETROLEUM GAS (LPG) MANUFACTURERS TO ADOPT A UNIFORM TYPE OF VALVE AND REGULATOR APPLICABLE TO ALL KINDS OF ELEVEN KILOGRAM (11 KG.) CYLINDER AND TO INSTALL AN EFFECTIVE MEASURING DEVICE IN THE CYLINDER TO ACCURATELY DETECT THE ACTUAL WEIGHT OF EACH CYLINDER
rows.abstract: Requires the liquified petroleum gas (LPG) manufacturers to adopt a standard type of cylinder valve and regulator applicable to all kinds of eleven kilogram (11 kg.) cylinder so as not to burden the consumers of the non-availabilit y of any particular brand, and to install an effective measuring devise to accurately detect actual weight.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT CANCELLING AUTOMATIC APPROPRIATIONS FOR THE COUNTRY'S DEBT SERVICE REQUIREMENTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION THIRTY ONE OF THE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED ELEVEN HUNDRED SEVENTY-SEVEN, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "BUDGET REFORM DECREE OF 1977"
rows.abstract: Amends Section 31 of PD 1177, otherwise known as the Budget Reform Decree of 1977, thus giving Congress the sole power to appropriate for the country's debt service requirement.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 1995-07-27

rows.author: A012
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO STRENGTHEN THE JAIL AND PRISON SYSTEM IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Places all national, provincial, city or municipal jails under the jurisdiction of an office or a bureau under the supervision of the Department of Justice to ensure effective management and efficient enforcement of duties.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 1995-07-27

rows.author: A012
rows.title_full: AN ACT UPGRADING THE SALARIES OF THE MEMBERS OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Increases the basic monthly salary of the lowest paid member of the Philippine National Police to a minimum of FIVE THOUSAND PESOS (P5,000.00) per month, and adjusts correspondingly the basic monthly salaries of all other ranks upward.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 1995-07-27

rows.author: A012
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING ASSISTANCE AND SCHOLARSHIP TO THE FAMILY OF MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES AND THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE WHO DIE IN LINE OF DUTY, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Grants a free education in any government school and an annual financial assistance to one (1) member only of the family of a members of the Armed Forces of the Philippine or the Philippine National Police who dies in the performance of his duty orget killed in battle or dies from battle-related causes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1995-07-27

rows.author: A012
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING FREE MEDICAL ASSISTANCE AND HOSPITALIZATION TO MEMBERS OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL POLICE AND TO IMMEDIATE MEMBERS OF THEIR FAMILIES
rows.abstract: Grants free medical assistance and hospitalization , to a member of the Philippine National Police who gets sick due to natural causes or due to accident or battle-related causes. Extends such grant to the immediate members of the family with entitlement to fifty (50%) per cent discount on the total hospital bills.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC ORDER AND SECURITY since 1995-07-27

rows.author: A012
rows.title_full: AN ACT REPEALING BATAS PAMBANSA BLG. 22 AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Repeals, in toto, Batas Pambansa Blg. 22, otherwise known as "An Act Penalizing the Mking or Drawing and Issuance of a Check Without Sufficient Funds  for Credit and for other purposes."  Is based on the observation that BP Blg. 22 has not been an effective deterrent to the nefarious practice of issuing bouncing checks."
rows.status: Substituted by HB10477

first_reading.comm_act: change of ctte. ref'l from Banks & Financial Intermedia ries as per J. 66;  p. 12

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE PHILIPPINE AGRICULTURAL INSURANCE AND SECURITY SYSTEM, DEFINING ITS OBJECTIVES, POWERS, FUNCTIONS, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Charter of the Philippine Agricultural Insurance and Security System." Provides insurance coverage for the loss of lives or injury of farmers and fisherfolks who constitute a sizeable portion of the populace.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1995-07-27

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 1996-09-30
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 32 OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED 4670, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE MAGNA CARTA FOR PUBLIC SCHOOL TEACHERS
rows.abstract: Penalizes any person who willfully interferes with, restrains or coerces any teacher in the exercise of his rights with a fine of not less than one THOUSAND (P1,000.00) pesos nor more than TEN thousand (P10,000.00) pesos, or by imprisonment of SIX MONTHS BUT NOT MORE THAN SIX YEARS OR BOTH, in the discretion of the Court.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 1996-09-30, transmitted to on 1996-09-30 and received by the Senate on 1996

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING PREFERENTIAL POWER RATES TO PRODUCTIVE BUSINESS ENTERPRISES LOCATED IN THE INDUSTRIAL ZONES IDENTIFIED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF TRADE AND INDUSTRY IN DEPRESSED REGIONS WITH ABUNDANT INDIGENOUS POWER SUPPLY
rows.abstract: "Power Rate Incentive for Business Enterprises in Industrial Zones in the Depressed Regions." Provides for the lowering of power rates to enterprises in the industrial zones in the regions identified by the Department of Trade and Industry to enableto increase the power demand in these areas and promote and the proper exploration and development of energy resources in such regions.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 1995-07-27

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXTENDING THE PERIOD FOR MEMBERS OF CULTURAL COMMUNITIES TO PERFECT THEIR TITLES TO ANCESTRAL LANDS OCCUPIED BY THEM AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: EXTENDS the period within which the members of cultural communities can perfect their titles to the ancestral lands occupied by them TO A PERIOD OF TEN (10) years from the approval of this Act.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09125

rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING TAX CREDIT TO GUARANTORS OF LOANS  FOR RURAL LIVELIHOOD PROJECTS
rows.abstract: Grants a tax credit to a guarantor who incurs liability due to the default of a qualified borrower in an amount not exceeding thirty (30%) per centum of the total amount of liability.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1995-07-27

rows.author: A010
rows.title_full: AN ACT CONSTITUTING A CONSTITUTIONAL CONVENTION TO AMEND OR REVISE THE PRESENT CONSTITUTION, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Constitutional Convention Act of 1996" Calls for a Constitutional Convention, rather than a constituent assembly, to amend or revise the Constitution in order to make it clear, comprehensive and concise, thus making it a good Charte and provides for the election of two (2) delegates from every congressional district of the country whose terms shall commence on Jly 1, 1995 and convene in not more than one (1) year.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10303
